name: petr-ai-school
description: Petr's AI School: Marp lectures, an Obsidian wiki and the Quartz site that publishes them.

scripts.dev: npm run lectures:html && npm run site:serve
scripts.build: npm run lectures && npm run site:build
scripts.site:upgrade: git fetch upstream v5 && git subtree pull --prefix site upstream v5 --squash && npm --prefix site install
